description: This file defines the Root class in the Todaymade\Daux\Tree namespace, extending Directory. It manages configuration and active node state within a documentation tree structure.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: A class representing the root node of a documentation tree, managing configuration and active node hierarchy.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Root object with a configuration, setting directory pathways and resetting the active node.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration object associated with the root.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration object for the root.

methods.name: isHotPath
methods.description: Determines whether a given node is part of the 'hot path' based on the current active node.

methods.name: setActiveNode
methods.description: Sets the current active node in the tree.
